paragraphs: Hundreds of innocent children suffering from rare metabolic disorders struggle every day due to the high cost of life-saving formula milk and essential medical treatments. These precious little souls cannot digest regular food and rely on specialized nutrition and continuous medical care to survive.
Many parents are unable to afford this costly treatment, and without your help, their children's health is at serious risk. Your Zakat and donations can be their lifeline!
Be a reason for their smiles. Donate your Zakat & Sadaqah to support children battling Methylmalonic Acidemia and other metabolic disorders.
